method: e-rara OAI-PMH oai_dc (sets zuz, landkarten) for discovery → IIIF Presentation 2.0 manifest per title for verbatim title, imprint, creators, holding institution, rights, thumbnail and the stated "Kartendaten" extent; swisstopo WMTS 1.0.0 GetCapabilities for the Zeitreise, Siegfriedkarte and SWISSIMAGE Zeitreise editions and for the comparison layers in overlays.json. No title, date or coordinate is invented. Regenerate with: node scripts/fetch-records.mjs --out public/data

e-rara:zuz.rule: maps only, one entry per sheet, publication year ≤ 1900, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

e-rara:landkarten.rule: Swiss sheet maps from the landkarten set, requires a stated Kartendaten bbox

swisstopo:zeitreise.rule: curated Zeitreise editions (exact or nearest advertised Time value)

swisstopo:hiks-siegfried.rule: one record per decade advertised in the Siegfriedkarte Time dimension (1870–1949)

swisstopo:swissimage-1946.rule: the dedicated SWISSIMAGE 1946 historical aerial layer

skipped.reason: WMTS advertises this edition but serves empty tiles at the preview locations
